title: Why Japanese People Say Itadakimasu

aggregated_issues.problem: Overcorrects against mysticism: cafeteria is only a start button. Many Japanese readers remember thanks for the cook/food, and sometimes “lives in the meal,” as food education—not a temple rite.
aggregated_issues.suggestion: One hedged shokuiku sentence; still deny required doctrine.

aggregated_issues.location: Not a Church Prayer — postwar kyūshoku “standardized” the group start
aggregated_issues.problem: Overclaims origin. The humble verb and table phrase are older; school lunch spread a group recitation.
aggregated_issues.suggestion: Many adults learned a loud group start at lunch; that explains volume, not invention.

aggregated_issues.location: cosmic hymn / church / sacred pause / spell / password
aggregated_issues.problem: Mystic foil language mystifies itadakimasu while denying religion.
aggregated_issues.suggestion: Keep bless-you once. Cut spell/password/sacred. Retitle away from Church.
